details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a significant downturn, with Bitcoin (BTC) falling below $73,000 and Ethereum (ETH) dropping under $2,000. This plunge is attributed to escalating geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran, coupled with substantial outflows from US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs). Over $800 million in combined BTC and ETH ETF outflows were recorded, contributing to widespread liquidations across the derivatives market.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $73K as Geopolitical Tensions & ETF Outflows Impact Crypto Markets

details: Despite Ethereum's recent price dip below $2,000, the amount of ETH locked in staking protocols has reached an all-time high, accounting for over 32.4% of its total supply (approximately 39 million ETH). This indicates a strong long-term commitment from investors to secure the network and earn passive income, suggesting a potential supply shock as less ETH is available on exchanges.
title: Ethereum Staking Hits Record 32.4% of Supply Amid Price Weakness

details: Former President Donald Trump announced plans to codify a "future-proof" crypto market structure that cannot be undone by "Crypto Haters," aiming to cement the US as the global hub for digital asset innovation. This commitment comes as the White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB) reviews the Commodity Futures Trading Commission's (CFTC) proposed rulemaking on event contracts.
title: Trump Vows Permanent Crypto Market Structure, Blames "Crypto Haters" for Offshore Shift

details: Coinbase has rolled out a new feature allowing eligible users to instantly borrow USDC stablecoins against their Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other supported crypto assets. Powered by the Morpho lending protocol on the Base network, this service enables users to access liquidity without selling their holdings or undergoing traditional credit checks, offering loans with interest rates as low as 5%.
title: Coinbase Launches Instant USDC Borrowing Against Crypto Holdings
